errors.evidence: The description states there are seven categories for the audio duration chart, but the chart clearly shows eight categories on the x-axis (0-5, 6-10, 11-15, 16-20, 21-25, 26-30, 31-35, 35-40).
The description claims the bar for the '35-40 seconds' interval is the shortest, but the data label shows its value is 106. The bar for the '31-35 seconds' interval is shorter, with a value of 80.
The description states there are seven categories for the text length chart, but the chart shows eight categories on the x-axis (1-20, 21-40, 41-60, 61-80, 81-100, 101-120, 121-140, 140-160).

The description claims the bar for the '140-160 characters' interval is the shortest, but the data label shows its value is 188. The bar for the '121-140 characters' interval is shorter, with a value of 154.
